check_name: Staged rows = fact rows + excluded rows
how_handled: Row-count invariant: nothing is silently dropped

check_name: Fact total (GBP) = cleaned source total (GBP)
how_handled: Joins to dimensions neither lose nor multiply rows/value

check_name: Completely blank rows in source files
how_handled: Excluded (reason BLANK_ROW)

check_name: Rows with missing / non-numeric amount
how_handled: Excluded (reason INVALID_AMOUNT)

check_name: Rows with unparseable payment date
how_handled: Excluded (reason INVALID_DATE)

check_name: Rows with no supplier name
how_handled: Excluded (reason MISSING_SUPPLIER)

check_name: Exact duplicate rows (all business columns identical)
how_handled: Earliest copy kept, later copies excluded (reason DUPLICATE_ROW)

check_name: Valid payments missing a source Supplier ID
how_handled: Kept; supplier identity falls back to the normalised name

check_name: Payment date falls outside the month of the file it was published in
how_handled: Kept; report period = payment date, not file month

check_name: Calendar months with no payments between first and last month
how_handled: A missing monthly file would show here

check_name: Suppliers whose name appears in 2+ spellings (merged)
how_handled: Merged on normalised name (case, punctuation, LTD/LIMITED/PLC ...)

check_name: Supplier IDs reused by different suppliers
how_handled: Not merged - supplier identity is name-based; listed in dq_supplier_id_conflicts for the council to fix

check_name: Suppliers registered under 2+ Supplier IDs (duplicate vendor records)
how_handled: Combined into one supplier_key; listed in dq_multi_id_suppliers

check_name: Lines with a spend category not in ref_spend_category
how_handled: Shown as theme "Unmapped" - add the label to sql/02_reference_data.sql

check_name: Lines with a directorate not in ref_department
how_handled: Shown as expenditure_type "Unmapped" - add to sql/02_reference_data.sql

check_name: Distinct raw department labels merged into fewer clean directorates
how_handled: Capital / revenue prefixes split out into expenditure_type; &/AND variants unified

check_name: Possible duplicate payments (same supplier, day and amount, >= GBP 1,000)
how_handled: Kept; flagged is_possible_duplicate_payment. Many are legitimate batch payments - review list in dq_possible_duplicate_payments

check_name: Zero-value payment lines
how_handled: Kept

check_name: Credit notes / refunds (negative amounts)
how_handled: Kept - they reduce net spend; flagged is_credit_note

check_name: Lines under GBP 500 (threshold applies to the invoice, not each line)
how_handled: Kept; flagged is_below_threshold

check_name: Payments to redacted (personal-data) payees
how_handled: Each redacted payee ID kept separate; excluded from supplier rankings via is_redacted

check_name: Suppliers the sector heuristic could not classify
how_handled: supplier_type = "Other / unclassified" (mostly individuals, sole traders, surgeries)
